BRUKER DektakXT Stylus Profilometer (Manual Stage)​ 
The Bruker Dektak XT contact profilometer measures the thin film thickness of patterned features by sensing the deflection of a fine stylus that is raster scanning over features ranging in height from 1 mm down to 5 nm. 
Product Desription 
The Bruker Dektak XT contact profilometer measures the thin film thickness of patterned features by sensing the deflection of a fine stylus that is raster scanning over features ranging in height from 1 mm down to 5 nm. It is capable of mapping step heights and displaying topological three dimensional images of substrates ranging from 200 mm diameter wafers down to small pieces.
The system also includes a rapid vision system for laser micro material processing and for detecting fiducials and geometric structures on the substrate. 
Product Highlights 
X/Y stage with 6 inches of travel
Includes 2-3, 4-6, or 8″ wafer vacuum chuck
LIS 3, low inertia sensor with 1 to 15mg of force
3.1Mpixel color camera with selectable magnification
Optically flat scan block with 55mm scan length
Environmental enclosure to prevent against acoustic interferences
Better than 5 Å step height repeatability, 1 σ using a 0.1 μm step size
Soft materials mode – like PDMS and others 
Application 
Measurement of etch depth, deposition thickness, and film growth rates.
Measurement of surface roughness.
Thickness mapping.
